name: Hand-drawn sketch
one_line: Wobbly, hachured shapes that look drawn by hand rather than constructed by software
summary: Rectangles, circles and paths are drawn with a loose, slightly uneven line and filled with hatching, as if sketched on a whiteboard or in a notebook. It adds warmth and informality and signals work in progress. The wobble must stay stable between frames unless boil is wanted, and one sketch style should hold across a piece.

routes.one_line: Draw seeded sketchy shapes with Rough.js on a 2D canvas, redrawn from t

steps.does: Draw hachure, solid and path shapes with a fixed seed, redrawn on each seek

limits: Evidence covers hachure and solid fills with a fixed seed; other fill styles are untested
No SVG output evidence; this route is canvas only
Text and fine detail do not come out of it

routes.one_line: Author sketchy vector shapes with Rough.js and place them in an SVG scene

steps.does: Generate sketchy shape geometry as vector paths
Hold and animate the paths in an SVG scene

limits: Rough.js evidence excludes SVG output, so the handoff to SVG is untested
SVG evidence is one static rasterised file, with no animation or browser render

routes.one_line: Perturb path points with seeded noise in a vector library

steps.does: Build paths whose points are offset by seeded noise computed from t

limits: Paper.js evidence is a smoothed path and boolean union, not a hand-drawn look
Hachure fills would need writing yourself

source: references/art-director §7, §11; references/fx §8.1; tool records as of 2026-11-20
